host.semantic_evidence: Exact lossless references with verified round trip and retained raw facts
host.baseline: Published matching skill with native metadata planning; no candidate CLI backport. Feature-dependent adapter, equal actual caps and proof.

crab: An additive bounded relation between original peer declarations and literal peerDependenciesMeta entries, preserving raw names/provenance and existing Package fields/order. Recognize only supported boolean optional metadata; retain absent/malformed/unsupported/orphan entries explicitly. No npm/Yarn/pnpm execution, installation, resolution or inferred runtime requirement.

A bounded receiving-owned relation for an explicitly documented literal subset linking project PackageReference and acquired Directory.Packages.props PackageVersion declarations, retaining raw local/central versions, actual root/member provenance, local Version/VersionOverride distinctions and ambiguity. Conditions, imports, unevaluated expressions, unavailable or multiple roots and unsupported cases remain unknown. Preserve existing Package rows and declared-versus-resolved distinctions; no MSBuild, SDK/tool invocation, restoration or resolution.
devostasis: An additive bounded, typed failure-evidence design preserving actual parse exception category and known versus unavailable/resource-limited analysis. Do not infer a syntax defect from a resource-limited parser. Preserve default/legacy canonical shapes and IDs unless explicitly opted into a versioned extension. Avoid raw exception/source text leakage, code execution, invented source coordinates or health-score claims. AST span projection, contribution traces, cycle witnesses and the generic existing triage request are excluded.
beautifulrepo: A bounded mechanism for balanced reference-use display text that preserves reference label normalization/lookup, escape behavior, link/image precedence, source lines, masking and simple forms. Do not count literal receiving gaps alone or an unrelated label parser as a donor mechanism. Prior multiline-definition/source-span/line-index proposals are excluded.

A bounded receiving-owned precedence design that avoids treating a syntactically nested link as two independent valid links, distinguishes allowed image-in-link structures, and handles failed inner parses without discarding valid outer syntax. Preserve escapes, code/HTML masking, paragraph bounds, destinations, actual source lines and simple forms. No renderer or target execution.

parallel_schedule: Six fixed two-trial blocks in the balanced schedule; launch in declared order, wait both before next block, at most2concurrent. Separate native contexts/meters/artifact roots; shared frozen receiving/source facts only, no shared judgments. Same per-trial actual caps; no efficiency/generalization claim.
safety: No donor execution/tests/builds/installers/hooks. Shared inert acquisition/mining/catalogues only; no models/publication in CI. No merge/tag/release/scheduler.
evaluation_method: Use actual trial/index agreement, conservative at most one unique per declared need per arm and explicit peer canonical equivalences. All native verified-gap and either peer substantive positives remain in denominator. Missing reviewer gives no support and unknown usage fails. For no-lower precision, perfect observed candidate precision is provably no lower than any baseline precision in[0,1], even when empty baseline precision remains undefined; otherwise require known baseline and exact ratio comparison.
